disclaimer: Educational risk indicators for international-student scams; not proof of fraud or legal advice.

rubric.label: Urgency pressure
rubric.description: Deadlines, threats, countdowns, or pressure to act before verifying.

rubric.label: Authority impersonation
rubric.description: Claims to represent a university, embassy, immigration office, testing body, landlord, bank, or scholarship committee.

rubric.label: Sensitive data request
rubric.description: Asks for passport, visa, bank, login, transcript, ID, or family financial information.

rubric.label: Payment or fee request
rubric.description: Requests deposits, processing fees, gift cards, crypto, wire transfer, or unofficial payment methods.

rubric.label: Suspicious link/domain
rubric.description: Short links, lookalike domains, non-official email domains, or links mismatched with the claimed institution.

rubric.label: Vague institution/name
rubric.description: Generic office names, no named contact, or institution details that cannot be independently checked.

rubric.label: Generic greeting
rubric.description: Uses phrases like dear applicant/student instead of an application-specific identity.

rubric.label: Unrealistic reward/threat
rubric.description: Guaranteed scholarships/admission/visa or threats of cancellation, deportation, or account suspension.

rubric.label: Cross-border adaptation pattern
rubric.description: Mentions foreign currency, visa status, travel timeline, international courier, or unfamiliar local process to reduce scrutiny.
